confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from budget guides, not official price indexes. The guides disagree and mix 2025 and 2026 data, and they cover Tenerife generally more than the city centre, so restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence. Euro-to-USD conversion used an assumed rate from general knowledge; I did not search for it. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context. I did not inspect live booking pages or current listings, so they are low confidence.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is the Canary Islands and Tenerife, adjusted for Santa Cruz de Tenerife being a port and capital city that is generally cheaper than the southern resort areas of Costa Adeje and Playa de las Américas. Drink and meal prices were taken from the same regional guides and kept at the lower-to-middle end of their ranges. Accommodation was reasoned from comparable mid-sized Spanish port cities with steady tourism demand.
